fieldNotes.site: Ball Metal Container beverage-can plant at 11 Adams Rd, Cady Hill Industrial Park, Saratoga Springs NY (accessed off Weibel Ave). Complex = a large dark-roof main hall (long axis ~N-S, slightly rotated) joined to a grey/white process+office building on the E; docks face an interior SE court and the SW perimeter drive.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Perimeter chain-link fencing is present (visible in Street View), but the single entrance drive off Weibel Ave opens without a visible guard booth or barrier arm and splits to the truck court (left) and employee lot (right). Classed no-gate/no-guard, flagged medium.
fieldNotes.docks: ~20 doors split across two faces: the interior SE court (between the two buildings) and the SW face of the main hall, each with trailers backed in -> shipRcvSeparate true (flagged).
fieldNotes.dropYards: Trailer staging along the SW perimeter drive; ~14 visible, capacity ~38.
fieldNotes.railServed: The Cady Hill park has a rail line to the E, but no spur reaches the Ball building -> false.
fieldNotes.nearbyDunnage: A separate Ball dunnage/warehouse node is at 33 Cady Hill Blvd nearby (a distinct building N of the plant, not part of this audited site).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: SW edge of Saratoga Springs (small city, ~28k) in a wooded industrial park abutting a rec park -> Rural (edge-of-town). Cell coverage fine.

citations.claim: Ball's own Feb-2025 locations map lists Saratoga Springs, NY as an operating site.

verification.rationale: Long-running Ball Metal Container can plant, confirmed current on Ball's own 2025 locations map; not among Ball's closures.
